meta.title: Investor Presentation FY2023
meta.source_note: Investor Presentation delivered at Annual Investor Meet May 2023

passages.text: Management expects revenue growth of 20%+ annually through FY2026, driven by aggressive capacity commissioning in synthetic yarn spinning and expanding retail distributor reach across tier-2 cities.
Our Vision 2026 targets sustained margin enhancement through backward integration and sustained compound annual top-line growth of over 20 percent.
